role.en: CEO, SpaceX (incl. xAI / SpaceXAI); CEO, Tesla

why.en: Redefined the tempo of the compute arms race with Colossus. After folding xAI into SpaceX he now controls a model–rocket–car–robot stack no one else has, heading into what would be the largest IPO in history.
why.zh: 以 Colossus 的建设速度重新定义了算力军备竞赛的节奏。将 xAI 并入 SpaceX 后，他掌握着无人可比的「模型—火箭—车—机器人」闭环，并正走向史上最大规模的 IPO。

title.en: Running commentary on Grok, Colossus and the SpaceXAI merge
title.zh: 关于 Grok、Colossus 与 SpaceXAI 合并的持续发言

note.en: His primary and effectively only publishing channel; product and roadmap news usually breaks here first.
note.zh: 他的主要且实际上唯一的发布渠道，产品与路线图消息通常先在此出现。

title.en: xAI dissolves into SpaceX as SpaceXAI
title.zh: xAI 并入 SpaceX，更名 SpaceXAI

note.en: Grok and the other AI products move under SpaceX's corporate structure rather than remaining an independent entity.
note.zh: Grok 与其他 AI 产品转入 SpaceX 的公司架构，不再作为独立实体存在。

title.en: Grok 4.6 weeks away, 4.7 to follow
title.zh: Grok 4.6 数周内发布，4.7 紧随其后

note.en: 4.6 at 1.5T parameters; 4.7 at 2.1T, 'better in every way except slightly slower to serve'.
note.zh: 4.6 为 1.5 万亿参数；4.7 为 2.1 万亿，「除服务速度略慢外全面更强」。

title.en: As the prophecy foretold, Starship 42 will be the first tower catch
title.zh: As the prophecy foretold, Starship 42 will be the first tower catch

note.en: Musk announced that Starship 42 will attempt the first tower catch, a new milestone for SpaceX's reusable-launch program.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Starship 42将尝试首次塔式捕获，这是SpaceX可重复使用发射计划的新里程碑。

title.en: Worth noting that Grok @Bot has no free tier
title.zh: Worth noting that Grok @Bot has no free tier

note.en: Musk noted that Grok's chatbot has no free tier, clarifying xAI's monetization approach.
note.zh: 马斯克指出Grok聊天机器人没有免费版本，说明了xAI的商业化方式。

title.en: Grok @Bot is like hiring an awesome employee
title.zh: Grok @Bot is like hiring an awesome employee

note.en: Musk described xAI's Grok @Bot feature as being like hiring a great employee, promoting it as a practical AI assistant on X.
note.zh: 马斯克将xAI的Grok @Bot功能比作“雇用一位出色员工”，将其作为X平台上实用的AI助手进行推广。

title.en: 10k Starship launches/year is just from Starbase Louisiana
title.zh: 10k Starship launches/year is just from Starbase Louisiana

note.en: Musk said Starbase Louisiana alone could support 10,000 Starship launches a year, underlining the launch-cadence scale SpaceX is targeting.
note.zh: 马斯克表示，仅Starbase路易斯安那基地每年就能支持1万次星舰发射，凸显SpaceX追求的发射节奏规模。

title.en: 🇺🇸 Robotaxi Houston 🇺🇸
title.zh: 🇺🇸 Robotaxi Houston 🇺🇸

note.en: Musk announces the expansion of Tesla's Robotaxi service to Houston.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布特斯拉Robotaxi无人出租车服务扩展至休斯顿。

title.en: Starship Flight 15 static fire
title.zh: Starship Flight 15 static fire

note.en: Musk posted an update on the static fire test ahead of Starship Flight 15, part of SpaceX's ongoing Starship test campaign.
note.zh: 马斯克发布了星舰第15次飞行前静态点火测试的最新进展，是SpaceX星舰测试计划的一部分。

title.en: Starlink coming to EasyJet
title.zh: Starlink coming to EasyJet

note.en: Musk announced that Starlink is coming to EasyJet flights, extending its airline in-flight connectivity deals to another major European carrier.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布星链（Starlink）将登陆易捷航空（EasyJet）航班，把星链的机上联网合作扩展到另一家欧洲大型航空公司。

title.en: What are most important things to improve about Grok @Bot? Btw, make sure you’ve tried Bot recently, as over 100 features & fixes are released every week!
title.zh: What are most important things to improve about Grok @Bot? Btw, make sure you’ve tried Bot recently, as over 100 features & fixes are released every week!

note.en: Musk solicited public feedback on what to improve in Grok, noting the product ships over 100 features and fixes every week.
note.zh: 马斯克公开征求公众对Grok改进方向的意见，并提到该产品每周都会发布100多项功能更新与修复。

title.en: Grok @Bot is like hiring an incredibly competent chief of staff
title.zh: Grok @Bot is like hiring an incredibly competent chief of staff

note.en: Musk described xAI's Grok agent as being like hiring an exceptionally competent chief of staff.
note.zh: 马斯克将xAI的Grok智能体比作雇佣了一位极其能干的幕僚长。

title.en: Supervised FSD approved in Latvia! 🇱🇻
title.zh: Supervised FSD approved in Latvia! 🇱🇻

note.en: Tesla's Supervised Full Self-Driving received regulatory approval in Latvia, extending its rollout in Europe.
note.zh: 特斯拉的有监督全自动驾驶（FSD）获得拉脱维亚监管批准，进一步扩展其在欧洲的部署。

title.en: They are channeling Beria https://t.co/oqaYxQVvbS
title.zh: They are channeling Beria https://t.co/oqaYxQVvbS

note.en: Musk accused critics of 'channeling Beria,' comparing their tactics to Soviet secret-police methods — one of his sharper political broadsides this week.
note.zh: 马斯克指责批评者“效仿贝利亚”，将其手段比作苏联秘密警察，是他本周措辞最激烈的政治言论之一。

title.en: This is a fuller list of the limitations of supercomputer buildout. If anything is missing, however seemingly trivial, the compute doesn’t work.
title.zh: This is a fuller list of the limitations of supercomputer buildout. If anything is missing, however seemingly trivial, the compute doesn’t work.

note.en: Musk posted an expanded list of supercomputer-buildout bottlenecks, arguing that missing even one seemingly trivial component stalls the entire compute pipeline.
note.zh: 马斯克发布了一份更完整的超算建设限制清单，称哪怕遗漏一个看似细枝末节的环节，整条算力管线都会卡住。

title.en: We’re adding long press on like to send someone $1 via 𝕏 Money
title.zh: We’re adding long press on like to send someone $1 via 𝕏 Money

note.en: Musk announced a new X feature letting users long-press the like button to instantly send someone $1 via X Money.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布X的新功能：长按点赞按钮即可通过X Money向对方即时发送1美元。

title.en: The way to think about this is: How many super smart and dedicated people do you want to hire? And they keep getting better.
title.zh: The way to think about this is: How many super smart and dedicated people do you want to hire? And they keep getting better.

note.en: Musk argues the key competitive lever right now is simply hiring as many elite, dedicated people as possible, since their capabilities keep improving.
note.zh: 马斯克认为，当前竞争的关键在于尽可能多地招募顶尖且专注的人才，因为他们的能力还在不断提升。

title.en: Grok @Bot can now call someone or a business for you, make a request on your behalf, take notes on the response and send you a note summarizing the conversation
title.zh: Grok @Bot can now call someone or a business for you, make a request on your behalf, take notes on the response and send you a note summarizing the conversation

note.en: Musk announced that Grok's @Bot feature can now place a phone call on a user's behalf, take notes, and send back a summary of the conversation, a new agentic capability for Grok.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok的@Bot功能现在可以代用户拨打电话、记录对话内容并发回总结，这是Grok新增的智能体式能力。

title.en: The best way to use Grok @Bot is assume you are hiring a super competent employee
title.zh: The best way to use Grok @Bot is assume you are hiring a super competent employee

note.en: Musk advised that the best way to use Grok's @Bot is to treat it like hiring a highly competent employee, a tip on how users should approach prompting it.
note.zh: 马斯克建议使用Grok的@Bot功能时应把它当作雇佣一名能力超强的员工，这是他对用户该如何向其提问给出的建议。

title.en: Grok @Bot saves sensitive info in a vault
title.zh: Grok @Bot saves sensitive info in a vault

note.en: Musk described a new Grok feature that stores a user's sensitive information in a secure vault.
note.zh: 马斯克介绍了Grok的一项新功能：将用户的敏感信息存储在安全保险库中。

title.en: Correct. Using Starlink, a civilian commercial service, for offensive drone strikes to kill people has never been allowed, nor should it be. Starshield, a diffe
title.zh: Correct. Using Starlink, a civilian commercial service, for offensive drone strikes to kill people has never been allowed, nor should it be. Starshield, a diffe

note.en: Musk publicly drew a hard line between Starlink (civilian service, never used for lethal drone strikes) and Starshield (a separate, US-government-controlled system), clarifying SpaceX's policy on military use of its satellite network.
note.zh: 马斯克公开划清界限：星链（民用商业服务）从未也不应被用于致命无人机打击，Starshield是另一套由美国政府控制的系统，借此澄清SpaceX卫星网络的军事使用政策。

title.en: Grok Bot now integrates with your phone apps
title.zh: Grok Bot now integrates with your phone apps

note.en: Musk announces that Grok Bot now integrates with users' phone apps, expanding Grok's on-device reach.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok Bot现已能与用户手机应用集成，扩大Grok在设备端的覆盖范围。

title.en: This is literally their plan to end democracy in America
title.zh: This is literally their plan to end democracy in America

note.en: Musk makes a sharp political accusation, calling a rival plan an attempt to 'end democracy in America' — a stance that drew over 9,000 likes.
note.zh: 马斯克发出尖锐政治指控，称某项计划是「终结美国民主」的企图，该言论获得逾9000个赞。

title.en: Grok @Bot is an incredible life & business manager. Can help you with almost anything! Like having a genius employee.
title.zh: Grok @Bot is an incredible life & business manager. Can help you with almost anything! Like having a genius employee.

note.en: Musk publicly endorsed Grok's new Bot assistant as a capable life-and-business manager, a post that drew over 3 million views.
note.zh: 马斯克公开称Grok的Bot助手是出色的生活与商业管家，该帖获得超300万次浏览。

title.en: Honest feedback from Grok and Fable
title.zh: Honest feedback from Grok and Fable

note.en: Musk posted about giving honest feedback comparing Grok and a system called Fable.
note.zh: 马斯克发帖谈论对Grok和Fable给出诚实反馈的对比。

title.en: Grok @Bot can help protect and fix your credit rating. Just ask it to do so!
title.zh: Grok @Bot can help protect and fix your credit rating. Just ask it to do so!

note.en: Musk promoted a new Grok feature that can help users protect and fix their credit rating, an example of xAI's assistant adding consumer-facing tools.
note.zh: 马斯克宣传了Grok的新功能，可帮助用户保护和修复信用记录，体现xAI助手正在增加面向消费者的工具。

title.en: Talarico would vote to take away your kids and transition them, not just in Texas, but nationwide. Pure evil.
title.zh: Talarico would vote to take away your kids and transition them, not just in Texas, but nationwide. Pure evil.

note.en: Musk publicly attacked Texas candidate James Talarico over trans policy, a post that drew unusually high engagement for him.
note.zh: 马斯克公开抨击得州候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科在跨性别议题上的立场，该帖获得了异常高的互动量。

title.en: Talarico, the creep, in his OWN words
title.zh: Talarico, the creep, in his OWN words

note.en: A follow-up attack on Talarico quoting his own words, Musk's highest-engagement post in this batch.
note.zh: 马斯克继续抨击塔拉里科并引用其原话，是本批次中互动量最高的一条帖子。

title.en: People are buying FSD with a car attached, not the other way around
title.zh: People are buying FSD with a car attached, not the other way around

note.en: Musk argues Tesla's FSD software, not the car itself, is now the product people are buying — a stance on where Tesla's value lies.
note.zh: 马斯克提出观点：人们买特斯拉其实是为了FSD软件，车只是附带品，体现了他对特斯拉价值所在的立场。

title.en: Two important changes to timeline recommendations: - New AI/SI ranking model that predicts probable time spent much better - Retrieval model trained to surface
title.zh: Two important changes to timeline recommendations: - New AI/SI ranking model that predicts probable time spent much better - Retrieval model trained to surface

note.en: Posted that X is rolling out a new AI/SI model to better predict watch time and a retrieval model that surfaces posts users read all the way through, changing how the timeline ranks content.
note.zh: 发文称X平台将上线新的AI/SI模型以更好预测用户停留时长，并用检索模型找出用户会完整读完的帖子，从而改变时间线排序方式。

title.en: The value of Terafab’s output will place it in the top 20 of country GDP in a single building
title.zh: The value of Terafab’s output will place it in the top 20 of country GDP in a single building

note.en: Musk claimed Terafab's output alone would be valuable enough to rank in the top 20 of world GDP by country, a marker of the scale he expects from the new compute facility.
note.zh: 马斯克宣称Terafab单一工厂的产出价值将足以跻身全球GDP排名前20的国家之列，显示他对这一新计算工厂规模的预期。

title.en: “Lack of electricity” is an oversimplification. Everything is hard about bringing massive compute online at extremely high speed. If there was twice as much tim
title.zh: “Lack of electricity” is an oversimplification. Everything is hard about bringing massive compute online at extremely high speed. If there was twice as much tim

note.en: Musk argues that 'lack of electricity' oversimplifies the real difficulty of bringing massive compute online quickly, pointing to engineering and timeline constraints behind the AI compute buildout.
note.zh: 马斯克表示“缺电”是对问题的过度简化，强调快速上线大规模算力所面临的真正工程与时间难题，涉及AI算力建设的核心瓶颈。

title.en: As crazy as this sounds, $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is no longer impossible https://t.co/jF3Wue95nL
title.zh: As crazy as this sounds, $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is no longer impossible https://t.co/jF3Wue95nL

note.en: Musk predicts SpaceX could hit $1 trillion in revenue by 2028, a sign of how aggressively he is scaling the Starlink/Starship business alongside his AI ambitions.
note.zh: 马斯克预测SpaceX到2028年营收可能达到1万亿美元，显示他在推进Starlink/星舰业务和AI布局上的激进扩张。

title.en: So many people are going to get one-shotted by super persuasive super intelligences and I might be one of them
title.zh: So many people are going to get one-shotted by super persuasive super intelligences and I might be one of them

note.en: Musk warned that "super persuasive super intelligences" could manipulate people, including himself — a stance on AI persuasion risk that drew nearly 6,000 likes and nationwide attention.
note.zh: 马斯克警告"超级说服力的超级智能"可能操纵人类（包括他自己），这条关于AI说服风险的表态获得近6000个赞，引发广泛关注。

title.en: Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many.
title.zh: Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many.

note.en: Musk announced on X that starting next year he will give one of his SpaceX shares to every child in America, calling it the first of several such moves.
note.zh: 马斯克在X上宣布，明年起将把一股SpaceX股份送给每个美国孩子，并称这只是未来多项类似举措中的第一个。

title.en: Grok @Bot might turn out to be your favorite employee
title.zh: Grok @Bot might turn out to be your favorite employee

note.en: Musk predicts Grok's agentic bot capabilities could make it a standout 'employee,' underscoring xAI's push into autonomous AI agents.
note.zh: 马斯克预测Grok的智能体机器人能力可能使其成为出色的「员工」，凸显xAI在自主智能体方向上的推进。

title.en: This really works! Grok @Bot can pay for itself.
title.zh: This really works! Grok @Bot can pay for itself.

note.en: Musk said Grok's new Bot feature is already paying for itself, an early signal of xAI's push to monetize Grok beyond chat.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok的新Bot功能已经能够自负盈亏，这是xAI推动Grok商业化变现的早期信号。

title.en: Our team makes around around 20 improvements per day to Grok @Bot
title.zh: Our team makes around around 20 improvements per day to Grok @Bot

note.en: Musk says his team is shipping around 20 improvements a day to the Grok chatbot, a concrete claim about xAI's iteration pace.
note.zh: 马斯克表示团队每天为Grok聊天机器人推出约20项改进，透露出xAI产品迭代的具体节奏。

title.en: The new Tesla Roadster accelerates faster than a fighter jet taking off from an aircraft carrier
title.zh: The new Tesla Roadster accelerates faster than a fighter jet taking off from an aircraft carrier

note.en: Musk claimed the new Tesla Roadster accelerates faster than a fighter jet taking off from a carrier, a specific performance claim about Tesla's next flagship vehicle.
note.zh: 马斯克称新款Tesla Roadster的加速度超过战斗机从航母甲板起飞，这是他对特斯拉下一代旗舰车型性能作出的具体宣称。

title.en: True, even SpaceX’s competitor’s FUTURE plans are behind Starship 🤣🤣
title.zh: True, even SpaceX’s competitor’s FUTURE plans are behind Starship 🤣🤣

note.en: Musk posted on X that even competitors' future rocket plans still lag behind the already-flying Starship.
note.zh: 马斯克在X上发文称，即便是竞争对手的未来火箭计划，也落后于已经投入飞行的星舰。

title.en: Grok @Bot can call restaurants by phone and book you a table
title.zh: Grok @Bot can call restaurants by phone and book you a table

note.en: Musk announced that Grok's new @Bot agent can place phone calls on a user's behalf, such as calling a restaurant to book a table — xAI's first voice-calling agent feature.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布Grok新推出的@Bot智能体可以代表用户拨打电话，例如致电餐厅订座，这是xAI首个具备语音通话能力的智能体功能。

title.en: Grok @Bot is like hiring an incredibly competent employee
title.zh: Grok @Bot is like hiring an incredibly competent employee

note.en: Musk argued Grok's agentic bot functions like hiring a highly competent employee, a strong public endorsement of xAI's agent product that drew over 620,000 views.
note.zh: 马斯克称Grok的智能体机器人就像雇用了一名非常能干的员工，这是对xAI智能体产品的有力公开背书，浏览量超过62万次。

title.en: What it’s like trying to rent AI/SI compute https://t.co/SBdEXK31zc
title.zh: What it’s like trying to rent AI/SI compute https://t.co/SBdEXK31zc

note.en: Musk posted on how hard it currently is to rent AI/SI compute, a real complaint about the training-compute crunch that his own xAI/SpaceX stack competes for.
note.zh: 马斯克发帖吐槽如今租用AI/SI算力有多难，反映了连他自己的xAI/SpaceX也在争夺的训练算力紧张局面。

title.en: Since fate maximizes for ironic entertainment, it was inevitable that the “Roadster” would be a flying car
title.zh: Since fate maximizes for ironic entertainment, it was inevitable that the “Roadster” would be a flying car

note.en: Musk joked on X that the flying 'Roadster' was an inevitable twist of fate, teasing the car's planned flight capability.
note.zh: 马斯克在X上开玩笑说，“飞行版Roadster”的出现是命运讽刺式安排下的必然结果，暗示该车型即将具备飞行能力。

title.en: Future fun Roadster demos will include flying over the Snake River or maybe Grand Canyon and landing on its wheels and exceeding half the speed of sound
title.zh: Future fun Roadster demos will include flying over the Snake River or maybe Grand Canyon and landing on its wheels and exceeding half the speed of sound

note.en: Musk detailed upcoming Roadster flight demos over the Snake River or Grand Canyon, landing on its wheels at over half the speed of sound.
note.zh: 马斯克透露，未来的Roadster飞行演示将飞越蛇河或大峡谷，并以超过音速一半的速度降落稳稳落地。

title.en: Turns out the future does have flying cars https://t.co/6fexPp6SXI
title.zh: Turns out the future does have flying cars https://t.co/6fexPp6SXI

note.en: Musk posted that "the future does have flying cars," linking a video demo of the flying Tesla Roadster, which drew over 11,000 likes and nearly 120,000 views.
note.zh: 马斯克发帖称"原来未来真的有飞行汽车"，并附上飞行版特斯拉Roadster的演示视频，获得超过1.1万次点赞和近12万次浏览。

title.en: Tesla supervised self-driving approved in Slovakia 🇸🇰
title.zh: Tesla supervised self-driving approved in Slovakia 🇸🇰

note.en: Musk announced that Tesla's supervised self-driving has been approved for use in Slovakia, expanding the feature to a new European market.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布特斯拉的监督自动驾驶功能已获斯洛伐克批准，将该功能扩展至新的欧洲市场。

title.en: Going forward, all advertising on 𝕏 will be subject to a reasonable esthetic standard. Advertisers who post ads that are ugly, shrill, strident or overstate cla
title.zh: Going forward, all advertising on 𝕏 will be subject to a reasonable esthetic standard. Advertisers who post ads that are ugly, shrill, strident or overstate cla

note.en: Musk announced that X will begin holding advertisers to an 'aesthetic standard,' barring ads that are ugly, shrill or overstate product claims.
note.zh: 马斯克宣布X平台将对广告商实施“美学标准”，禁止丑陋、刺耳或夸大产品宣传的广告。

title.en: Grok @Bot got much faster
title.zh: Grok @Bot got much faster

note.en: Musk said Grok got noticeably faster.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok的响应速度明显变快。

title.en: Neuralink will help millions of people
title.zh: Neuralink will help millions of people

note.en: Musk argued Neuralink will help millions of people.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Neuralink将帮助数百万人。

title.en: The new Tesla Roadster is a candidate for greatest product demo of all time
title.zh: The new Tesla Roadster is a candidate for greatest product demo of all time

note.en: Musk called the new Tesla Roadster's demo one of the greatest product demos ever, a bold public claim about the vehicle's reveal.
note.zh: 马斯克称新款Tesla Roadster的演示是史上最佳产品演示之一，这是他对该车发布的一次大胆公开评价。

title.en: Grok @Bot is great for reviewing any legal docs, like contracts or estate planning. Just drop in the file and Bot figures it out.
title.zh: Grok @Bot is great for reviewing any legal docs, like contracts or estate planning. Just drop in the file and Bot figures it out.

note.en: Musk described Grok's Bot as capable of reviewing legal documents like contracts and estate plans, a specific capability claim for the product.
note.zh: 马斯克表示Grok的Bot功能可以审阅合同、遗产规划等法律文件，这是对该产品能力的具体说明。

title.en: China will be making a LOT of RAM in 2028
title.zh: China will be making a LOT of RAM in 2028

note.en: Musk predicted China will be producing a large volume of RAM by 2028, a claim about future global memory-chip supply that bears on AI compute capacity.

title.en: An interview with Elon Musk
title.zh: An interview with Elon Musk

note.en: His first extended interview since SpaceX's IPO, with The Economist's editor-in-chief Zanny Minton Beddoes, covering the combined rocket, model, car and robot business he now runs.
note.zh: SpaceX 上市后他的首次长篇专访，与《经济学人》总编辑 Zanny Minton Beddoes 对谈，谈及他如今统管的火箭、模型、汽车与机器人业务。

title.en: Elon Musk — "In 36 months, the cheapest place to put AI will be space”
title.zh: Elon Musk — "In 36 months, the cheapest place to put AI will be space”

note.en: Long-form Dwarkesh interview making his case for orbital data centres, the limits of scaling power on Earth, and what mass-manufacturing humanoid robots would take.
note.zh: Dwarkesh 长篇访谈，他在其中论证轨道数据中心的可行性、地球上电力扩张的极限，以及量产人形机器人需要什么条件。

title.en: #2404 - Elon Musk
title.zh: #2404 - Elon Musk

title.en: SpaceX closes $60B all-stock acquisition of Cursor maker Anysphere
title.zh: SpaceX 完成 600 亿美元全股票收购 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere

body.en: Largest venture-backed startup acquisition on record; ~391M SpaceX Class A shares issued. Cursor becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of the newly rebranded SpaceXAI division, with access to Colossus.
body.zh: 史上最大的风险投资支持创业公司收购案；发行约 3.91 亿股 SpaceX A 类股。Cursor 成为新更名的 SpaceXAI 部门下的全资子公司，并获得 Colossus 算力。

title.en: SpaceX combines with xAI at a $1.25T valuation
title.zh: SpaceX 与 xAI 合并，估值 1.25 万亿美元

body.en: The biggest merger of all time by value, consolidating rockets, Starlink, X and Grok ahead of a mega-IPO reportedly targeting up to $1.5T.
body.zh: 按金额计为史上最大并购，将火箭、Starlink、X 与 Grok 整合于一体，为据报目标最高 1.5 万亿美元的 IPO 铺路。

title.en: Grok 4.5 ships; Colossus 2 fully operational training Grok 5
title.zh: Grok 4.5 发布；Colossus 2 满负荷训练 Grok 5

body.en: Colossus 2 is a 1-gigawatt supercluster in Memphis. Grok 5 targets multi-trillion parameter scale; timing has slipped past the original Q1 2026 window.
body.zh: Colossus 2 是位于孟菲斯的 1 吉瓦超算集群。Grok 5 目标为万亿级参数规模，时间表已错过最初的 2026 Q1 窗口。

title.en: Elon Musk says long-term saving is 'pointless' as he expects an abundant future
title.zh: Elon Musk says long-term saving is 'pointless' as he expects an abundant future

body.en: Musk said in an interview that long-term saving is 'pointless' because he expects an abundant AI-driven future, extending his public case for a post-scarcity economy.
body.zh: 马斯克在一次采访中表示，长期储蓄“毫无意义”，因为他预期人工智能将带来富足的未来，延续了他对后稀缺经济的公开主张。

title.en: Elon Musk says long-term saving is 'pointless' as he expects a future of abundance
title.zh: Elon Musk says long-term saving is 'pointless' as he expects a future of abundance

body.en: Musk argued long-term saving will become 'pointless' as AI-driven abundance reshapes the economy, a stance tied to his broader post-scarcity vision.
body.zh: 马斯克认为随着AI带来的"丰裕"经济，长期储蓄将变得"毫无意义"，这一立场与他更宏观的后稀缺社会愿景相呼应。

title.en: Elon Musk's SpaceX buying out 418 homes near flagship AI data center, but only if they drop participation in lawsuit — report claims the company is targeting an entire neighborhood, but will only buy from people who don't pursue noise pollution complaints
title.zh: Elon Musk's SpaceX buying out 418 homes near flagship AI data center, but only if they drop participation in lawsuit — report claims the company is targeting an entire neighborhood, but will only buy from people who don't pursue noise pollution complaints

body.en: SpaceX is reportedly offering to buy out hundreds of homes near its flagship Colossus AI data center, conditioning payouts on residents dropping a lawsuit against the facility.
body.zh: 据报道，SpaceX提议收购其旗舰Colossus AI数据中心附近数百户住宅，但要求居民以撤销针对该设施的诉讼为条件。

title.en: ‘Elonville’: Why is Elon Musk’s xAI buying homes instead of land for AI data centers?
title.zh: ‘Elonville’: Why is Elon Musk’s xAI buying homes instead of land for AI data centers?

body.en: xAI has reportedly been buying residential homes rather than land to build out AI data center capacity, an unconventional expansion approach.
body.zh: 据报道，xAI正在购买住宅房屋而非土地来扩建AI数据中心，这是一种非常规的扩张方式。

title.zh: Delaware Senator Threatens to Subpoena Elon Musk Following Putin's 'Real Genius' Praise, Says Trump May Be 'Directly Involved' in Ukraine Starlink Disruption

body.zh: 特拉华州一名参议员威胁要传唤埃隆·马斯克，原因是普京公开称赞他，且有报道称特朗普可能知情星链在干扰乌克兰网络连接中的作用。

title.en: Jensen Huang Foresees Booming AI Demand, but Elon Musk's Warning Highlights a Different Risk
title.zh: Jensen Huang Foresees Booming AI Demand, but Elon Musk's Warning Highlights a Different Risk

body.en: Commentary paired Jensen Huang's bullish AI demand outlook against Elon Musk's warning of a different risk, highlighting a public disagreement between two of the industry's biggest infrastructure voices.
body.zh: 相关报道将黄仁勋对AI需求的乐观展望与埃隆·马斯克提出的另一种风险警告并列，凸显了两位AI基础设施领域重量级人物之间的公开分歧。

title.en: Elon Musk Wants Every American Kid to Own a Piece of SpaceX - KROC-AM
title.zh: Elon Musk Wants Every American Kid to Own a Piece of SpaceX - KROC-AM

body.en: Musk said he wants every American kid to be able to own a stake in SpaceX, a retail-ownership push tied to the company's approaching IPO.
body.zh: 马斯克表示希望让每个美国孩子都能持有SpaceX的股份，这一散户持股倡议与公司即将进行的IPO相关。

title.en: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Is Now a "Super Intelligence" Company
title.zh: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Is Now a "Super Intelligence" Company

body.en: Musk declared that SpaceX itself is now a 'super intelligence' company, signaling AI is central to the rocket maker's strategy alongside xAI.
body.zh: 马斯克宣称SpaceX本身已成为一家“超级智能”公司，表明人工智能已与xAI一起成为这家火箭公司战略的核心。

title.en: Elon Musk Says Tesla Robotaxi Expansion to Miami, Tampa Beaches Is ‘Coming Soon’ After Ron DeSantis’ Call
title.zh: Elon Musk Says Tesla Robotaxi Expansion to Miami, Tampa Beaches Is ‘Coming Soon’ After Ron DeSantis’ Call

body.en: Musk said Tesla's robotaxi service will expand to Miami and Tampa beach areas soon, following a call with Florida Governor Ron DeSantis.
body.zh: 马斯克表示，在与佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯通话后，特斯拉robotaxi服务即将扩展到迈阿密和坦帕海滩地区。

title.en: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Is Now a "Super Intelligence" Company
title.zh: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Is Now a "Super Intelligence" Company

body.en: Musk declared SpaceX is now a "superintelligence" company, folding its AI ambitions into the core identity of the business.
body.zh: 马斯克宣称SpaceX现在是一家“超级智能”公司，将AI业务纳入公司的核心定位。

title.zh: ‘Elonville’: Mississippi residents say Musk’s xAI is buying up homes if they don’t sue over noise

body.en: The Guardian reported xAI has been buying up homes near its Mississippi data center after residents complained about noise, showing the real-world footprint of its compute buildout.
body.zh: 《卫报》报道，xAI在密西西比数据中心附近因居民投诉噪音而大量收购房屋，凸显其算力扩张带来的现实影响。

title.zh: Elon Musk's SpaceXAI Is Reportedly Seeking To Buy 418 Mississippi Homes Near Its Power Plant. There's One Catch For Sellers. - 24/7 Wall St.

body.en: SpaceXAI is reportedly buying up homes near its Mississippi power plant as it expands the energy infrastructure behind its AI compute buildout.
body.zh: 据报道，SpaceXAI正在收购密西西比电厂附近的住宅，以扩建支撑其AI算力建设的能源基础设施。

title.en: Elon Musk says 'Robot RAM needs will exceed everything else on Earth'
title.zh: Elon Musk says 'Robot RAM needs will exceed everything else on Earth'

body.en: Musk predicted that memory (RAM) demand from robots will eventually exceed all other demand on Earth, underscoring his compute-and-hardware-scaling thesis.
body.zh: 马斯克预测机器人对内存（RAM）的需求最终将超过地球上其他一切需求，呼应他对算力与硬件规模扩张的判断。

title.en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk Says Starbase Louisiana Could Handle 10,000 Starship Launches a Year
title.zh: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk Says Starbase Louisiana Could Handle 10,000 Starship Launches a Year

body.en: Musk says SpaceX's Starbase Louisiana facility could support up to 10,000 Starship launches a year, a claim about the planned scale of Starship production and launch cadence.
body.zh: 马斯克表示，SpaceX位于路易斯安那州的Starbase基地未来每年可支持多达一万次星舰发射，这是对星舰生产与发射节奏规划规模的说法。

title.en: Vladimir Putin hails Elon Musk’s ‘genius’ amid plans for Russian Starlink
title.zh: Vladimir Putin hails Elon Musk’s ‘genius’ amid plans for Russian Starlink

body.en: Putin publicly praised Musk's 'genius' and said Russia is coordinating with him on Starlink, inserting Musk into a geopolitically sensitive dispute over satellite internet in Russia.
body.zh: 普京公开称赞马斯克是“天才”，并表示俄罗斯正与他协调星链事宜，让马斯克卷入一场涉及俄罗斯卫星互联网的地缘政治争议。

title.en: Elon Musk says he can build a wireless carrier in two to three years. Is that possible?
title.zh: Elon Musk says he can build a wireless carrier in two to three years. Is that possible?

body.en: Musk said he could build a wireless carrier within two to three years, a claim that would extend Starlink/SpaceX into telecom infrastructure.
body.zh: 马斯克表示他能在两到三年内建成一家无线运营商，这一说法意味着星链/SpaceX将扩展进入电信基础设施领域。

title.en: Elon Musk Invests $1 Billion in Skydance After Merger
title.zh: Elon Musk Invests $1 Billion in Skydance After Merger

body.en: Musk invests $1 billion in Skydance following its merger, extending his reach from AI, rockets and EVs into Hollywood and media.
body.zh: 马斯克在Skydance完成合并后向其投资10亿美元，将自己的版图从AI、火箭和电动车进一步延伸到好莱坞与媒体行业。

title.en: Tesla’s Cybercab Fleet Expands Tenfold in Just a Month, Elon Musk Says Driverless Mileage Is Growing ‘Like a Rocket Going to Orbit’
title.zh: Tesla’s Cybercab Fleet Expands Tenfold in Just a Month, Elon Musk Says Driverless Mileage Is Growing ‘Like a Rocket Going to Orbit’

body.en: Musk said Tesla's Cybercab fleet in Austin grew roughly tenfold in a month and that driverless mileage is scaling rapidly, ahead of a planned expansion to Dallas and consumer sales by year-end.
body.zh: 马斯克表示特斯拉Cybercab车队在奥斯汀一个月内增长近十倍，无人驾驶里程快速增长，计划年底前扩展至达拉斯并向消费者销售。

title.en: Group of House Democrats calls for probe into Elon Musk's role in slowdown of Ukraine's access to Starlink
title.zh: Group of House Democrats calls for probe into Elon Musk's role in slowdown of Ukraine's access to Starlink

body.en: House Democrats formally demanded a federal investigation into Musk's alleged role in ordering a slowdown of Starlink/Starshield service to Ukraine's military, a major controversy over his control of critical wartime infrastructure.
body.zh: 多名众议院民主党人正式要求联邦调查马斯克是否下令减慢乌克兰军方的Starlink/Starshield服务，这一争议凸显他对关键战时基础设施的掌控力。

title.en: Elon Musk Warning Triggers Selloff Across Major Neocloud Stocks
title.zh: Elon Musk Warning Triggers Selloff Across Major Neocloud Stocks

body.en: Musk warned that over 200 'neocloud' AI compute providers face 'guppy-level death and consolidation' due to debt and thin credit, a call that triggered a real selloff in CoreWeave, Nebius and other neocloud stocks.
body.zh: 马斯克警告200多家"云新贵"AI算力提供商因债务高、信用薄弱将面临"小鱼式死亡与整合"，该言论引发CoreWeave、Nebius等云新贵股票的实际抛售。

title.en: Judge blocks federal government's bid to dismiss NAACP lawsuit against Elon Musk's xAI power plant in Mississippi
title.zh: Judge blocks federal government's bid to dismiss NAACP lawsuit against Elon Musk's xAI power plant in Mississippi

body.en: A federal judge refused to dismiss the NAACP's lawsuit over the power plant supplying Musk's xAI Colossus data center in Mississippi, keeping the legal challenge to its energy buildout alive.
body.zh: 一名联邦法官拒绝驳回NAACP就密西西比州为马斯克xAI"Colossus"数据中心供电的发电厂提起的诉讼，使这一能源建设相关法律挑战继续进行。

title.en: Elon Musk’s 7-Minute AI ‘Odyssey’ Draws Fire After His Nolan Criticism
title.zh: Elon Musk’s 7-Minute AI ‘Odyssey’ Draws Fire After His Nolan Criticism

body.en: After months of attacking Christopher Nolan's Odyssey casting as a betrayal of Homer, Musk released a 7-minute Grok-generated AI version of the story, which drew its own backlash over historical inaccuracies.
body.zh: 马斯克此前多次批评诺兰版《奥德赛》选角背离荷马原著，随后发布了Grok生成的7分钟AI版《奥德赛》，却因自身的历史细节失真引发新一轮争议。

title.en: Elon Musk reportedly invests $1bn in Skydance
title.zh: Elon Musk reportedly invests $1bn in Skydance

title.en: SpaceX ($SPCX) Locks in $40B GPU Financing Commitment as Elon Musk Expects Widespread Failures Among Specialized AI Cloud Operators
title.zh: SpaceX ($SPCX) Locks in $40B GPU Financing Commitment as Elon Musk Expects Widespread Failures Among Specialized AI Cloud Operators

body.en: SpaceX locks in a $40 billion GPU financing commitment, a major compute-buildout move, with Musk predicting widespread failure among specialized AI cloud providers.
body.zh: SpaceX锁定400亿美元GPU融资承诺，是一次重大算力扩张举措，马斯克同时预测专用AI云服务商将大规模失败。

title.en: Elon Musk argues that the threat of Russian anti-satellite attacks is a reason to restrict Starlink’s military use in Ukraine
title.zh: Elon Musk argues that the threat of Russian anti-satellite attacks is a reason to restrict Starlink’s military use in Ukraine

body.en: Musk argues the threat of Russian anti-satellite attacks is reason to restrict Starlink's military use in Ukraine, a notable public stance on how his satellite network should be used in the war.
body.zh: 马斯克认为俄罗斯反卫星打击的威胁是限制Starlink在乌克兰军事用途的理由，这是他对自己卫星网络在战争中应如何使用的一次重要公开表态。

title.en: Elon Musk says Ukraine’s military violated Starlink’s terms of service
title.zh: Elon Musk says Ukraine’s military violated Starlink’s terms of service

body.en: Musk publicly accused Ukraine's military of violating Starlink's terms of service, a stance with direct bearing on SpaceX's role in the war.
body.zh: 马斯克公开指责乌克兰军方违反星链服务条款，这一表态直接关系到SpaceX在俄乌战争中所扮演的角色。

title.zh: Elon Musk's grand plan for AI-generated movie faces reality check after Grok releases 7 minutes

body.zh: xAI的Grok发布了其AI生成电影项目《Odyssey》的首批片段，反响不佳，这是对马斯克押注AI制作电影的一次早期考验。

title.en: Elon Musk reveals AI ‘Odyssey’ to rival Christopher Nolan. Is it any good?
title.zh: Elon Musk reveals AI ‘Odyssey’ to rival Christopher Nolan. Is it any good?

body.zh: 马斯克旗下xAI发布了一集七分钟的AI生成《奥德赛》短片，被定位为对标克里斯托弗·诺兰式电影制作的尝试。

title.en: Elon Musk promised an AI epic to rival Christopher Nolan. Viewers got a seven-minute glitch
title.zh: Elon Musk promised an AI epic to rival Christopher Nolan. Viewers got a seven-minute glitch

body.en: Musk's Grok released a seven-minute AI-generated episode of 'The Odyssey' meant to rival Christopher Nolan's film, but it drew widespread mockery online for glitchy, inconsistent visuals.
body.zh: 马斯克旗下Grok发布了一集七分钟的AI生成《奥德赛》，意图与诺兰的同名电影一较高下，却因画面粗糙、人物前后不一致而在网络上遭到广泛嘲讽。

title.en: Elon Musk reveals AI ‘Odyssey' to rival Christopher Nolan. Is it any good?
title.zh: Elon Musk reveals AI ‘Odyssey' to rival Christopher Nolan. Is it any good?

title.zh: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says

title.en: Elon Musk confirms $40 billion SpaceX debt deal for AI chips, warns of neocloud shakeout
title.zh: Elon Musk confirms $40 billion SpaceX debt deal for AI chips, warns of neocloud shakeout
